model: Series DHC Digihelic differential pressure controller, BACnet MS/TP
applies_to: Dwyer Series DHC Digihelic panel-mount differential pressure controllers with two relays, analog outputs and RS-485 set to BACnet MS/TP.
summary: The DHC Digihelic is a differential pressure gauge, transmitter and two-relay controller that can also show velocity or flow. Its RS-485 port runs Modbus RTU (factory setting) or BACnet MS/TP, picked in the Conn menu. Over BACnet it exposes pressure, derived velocity and flow, peak and valley, and all set point, alarm, relay and external input settings as writable objects.
notes: Pressure, velocity and flow units are model specific; the BACnet units property is set separately from the display units.
Peak, valley, set point, alarm and output limit values use the units of the process mode picked in MV 1.
The overview table prints AV 12 as "Set Point 2 Reset"; its property table names it "Set Point 2 Reset Value" (used here).
Alarm and input delays (PIV 1-2) have a maximum of 3600; the manual does not print their units.

source.title: Series DHC Digihelic Differential Pressure Controller - Specifications, Installation and Operating Instructions

integration.summary: Pick BAC in the Prot sub menu, set an address, then read AI 1 pressure (or AV 1 / AV 2 velocity and flow). Set point, alarm and relay settings are all writable over the network if the BMS should own them.

minimum_points.name: Set Point 1 Trigger Value
minimum_points.why: Set point 1 trigger value, process units

setup: Protocol is Modbus RTU from the factory; choose BAC in Conn > Prot to use BACnet MS/TP.
Address range 0-127, factory 127; baud 9600 to 115200 or auto (factory). Parity and stop bits are fixed at none and 1 on BACnet.
Device instance and device name default to 607xxx and follow the address until written over the network.
DeviceCommunicationControl and ReinitializeDevice need the password "Dwyer".
gotchas: Peak and valley (AV 3-4) cannot be reset over the network.
Alarm status BVs can only be written inactive when Manual Alarm Reset (BV 9) is on and the condition has cleared.
A change of bus serial settings needs a power cycle to rerun auto serial configuration.
